_comment: Manual corrections applied on top of the portfolio.buy-it.gr import. Edit this file, not projects.json — scripts/import-projects.mjs reapplies it on every re-import.

excludeUrls._comment: Substring match on a project's URL. Staging mirrors, .pages.dev preview hosts, internal tooling and sub-projects that are not separate work.

excludeTitles._comment: Exact title match, for entries that carry no URL.

reurl._comment: Point a project at its production domain instead of the .pages.dev host recorded in the export. Keyed by exact title.

retab._comment: Replace a project's service categories. Keyed by exact title.

add._comment: Work that is not in the portfolio export.
